'''Belsavis Orbital security''' was an organization responsible for monitoring arrivals to to the planet-prison [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and maintaining the [[Macula Station]]. [[Sulle]] was a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the orbital security.
